names.note: The name as days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 13721 gives it, «Киприан (Нелидов), иеромонах, прмч.», with the grade and the rank taken off. The day line prints the bare forename «Киприана» in the genitive and no surname, so the surname is read off the name link; it stays in the parentheses the calendar itself prints, which BRIEF-ADDENDUM §2 keeps out of the fold key. Measured with the gate's own fold before writing: 'киприан нелидов' has no holder, where a bare «Киприан» would meet the twelve Cyprian folders this corpus holds.

death.note: The year the day line gives him: «Прмч. Киприана (1934).» It is the only year on either page; the name page gives no year of birth and no date within the year.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 3 июня ст. ст. — «Прмч. Киприана (1934).»

attestations.note: The day's fourth entry of six, and a line and a name page and nothing else: «Прмч. Киприана (1934).». Name page 13721 heads him «Киприан (Нелидов), иеромонах, прмч.» and lists «26 января (Новомуч.) , 3 июня»; it carries no life, no icon, no place, no diocese, no monastery and no year of birth, and there is no /Life/ page for him on the site. Прмч. is преподобномученик, a venerable-martyr, and иеромонах is the hieromonk in `types`; no `office` was invented for him. `grep -rl` over the corpus for «Нелидов» and for the Latin stem returned nothing. «26 января (Новомуч.)» was not read, and azbyka.ru was not read.
